description:
The price of staying is invoiced monthly. You just never see the bill.

The cost of going for it is obvious: money, time, the chance it doesn’t work. You can see it, so you’re careful with it.

The cost of staying exactly where you are is invisible. Same revenue, another year. The clients you never called. The price you never raised. The version of you that stays “almost ready”. Nobody sends you that bill, so you treat it as free.

It isn’t. It’s the most expensive thing in your business, because it’s charged every month and it never stops.

💬 Put a number on it. What has “not yet” cost you this year? Comment it.

👉 If you want to find out why you keep paying it, follow me and comment NOW. I’ll ask you five questions in your DMs.
